title: Bit Counting (Popcount), Highest Set Bit, and Bit Reversal
description:
Bit counting algorithms are used in error correction (parity checks), scheduler priority resolution, and embedded signal processing.

### Requirements:
1. `count_set_bits(uint32_t x)`: Count set bits using Brian Kernighan's trick (`x &= x - 1`).
2. `find_highest_set_bit(uint32_t x)`: Find index of highest set bit (0-31), or -1 if x is 0.
3. `reverse_bits(uint32_t x)`: Mirror all 32 bits.
hint: Brian Kernighan's algorithm runs in O(k) loops where k is the number of 1s in the integer. In each step, `x &= (x - 1)` clears the least significant 1-bit.
